recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and white t-shirt, set against a split-color weathered background of teal-green and vibrant blue, featuring heavy, distressed slab-serif typography and a circular graphic emblem.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject sits at the intersection of the blue and green vertical background split
Large display text overlaps the green background and the subject's right arm
Circular emblem acts as a visual anchor below the secondary text line
coreInvariants: Weathered, peeling paint texture on all background surfaces
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and white shirt
Distressed, stamp-like texture applied to the primary display font

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, captured from the waist up, leaning forward with arms resting on knees.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white t-shirt provides a bright central focal point against the saturated background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the large display text on the left, then follow the vertical line of the arm to the circular emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper left corner occupied by a weathered wooden frame element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant cerulean blue and muted teal-green background panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the t-shirt and straw-colored cowboy hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow-gold for secondary text and emblem highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background colors contrasted with the neutral tones of the subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Deep forest green for primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and rounded sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses blocky, thick slabs with sharp corners
Secondary text uses a monolinear, rounded lowercase sans-serif
Emblem text follows a circular path around a central compass-like icon
characterSpecificRedesigns: Artificial weathering/erosion applied to the fill of the slab serif letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, textured slab serif with a clean, rounded lowercase sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Circular compass/sunburst emblem with text on a path
Weathered wooden frame in the top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab structure and wide proportions.
Matches the friendly, monolinear lowercase subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a straw cowboy hat and white t-shirt sitting against a wall with a vertical split between weathered teal-green and bright blue paint. A rustic wooden frame is visible in the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, dark green distressed slab-serif text on the left, followed by a pale yellow rounded sans-serif subtitle. Place a circular compass emblem at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Text must have a visible eroded texture
The blue and green background split must align with the subject's center

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Is the slab serif text sufficiently heavy and distressed?
Does the circular emblem feel integrated into the layout?
Is the color split between blue and green distinct yet weathered?
Does the subject's white shirt act as the primary light source for the composition?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic, dual-toned weathered background with a centered subject in neutral attire, overlaid with high-contrast, textured slab-serif display type and a secondary rounded sans-serif subtitle.
